title: Construction of a locally finitely presented universal rank-match representative
statement: Let f : X → S be flat, proper and locally of finite presentation, and let E be a finite locally free module on X. There exist a scheme W′ and an immersion j′ : W′ → S locally of finite presentation such that, for every g : T → S, g factors through j′ if and only if PicardUniversalRankMatch f E g (def-sc-picard-universal-rank-match). This construction assumes no pre-existing representing immersion and asserts no comparison isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 0BDP, first three proof paragraphs; 0B91; 0BDL. Rank decomposition adapted to omit the structure-pushforward hypothesis by excluding mixed-rank fibres.

proof.text: The images of each clopen rank locus of E and its complement are clopen, by openness of flat locally finitely presented morphisms and closedness of proper morphisms. Inside the clopen image of X, remove the image of the complement of rank r to obtain pairwise disjoint clopen homogeneous-rank components S_r. A mixed-rank fibre has an open neighbourhood in the images of two different ranks, meeting no S_r; the empty-fibre component is clopen. Testing residue fields shows every map satisfying universal rank matching lands in the union of the homogeneous and empty-fibre components.

On S_r, the derived direct images of E and its dual are perfect and satisfy arbitrary derived base change. Their pullbacks have no negative cohomology; hence locally their Tor amplitude starts at zero.

Apply the universal lowest-cohomology rank-r locus theorem to both complexes on amplitude charts and take their fibre product. The comparison with ordinary pushforward and the fixed rank of E identify this universal property with the rank-match clause.

The local representing immersions glue uniquely on chart overlaps. Unite the disjoint S_r representatives and the empty-fibre component. Immersion and local finite presentation are local on the target; mixed-rank fibres have neighbourhoods meeting none of these representatives. On empty fibres all pushforwards are zero and the pulled-back rank clause is vacuous, so rank zero supplies that component.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_picardUniversalRankMatchLocus_finitePresentation_core
    {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] :
    ∃ (W' : Scheme.{u}) (j' : W' ⟶ S),
      IsImmersion j' ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation j' ∧
      ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S),
        (∃ h : T ⟶ W', h ≫ j' = g) ↔ PicardUniversalRankMatch f E g
